sentences.en: The FEM for the assembly parts of piston, gudgeon pin and small-end of connecting rod is constructed to investigate a diesel engine piston with an oscillating-oil-cooling channel.

sentences.en: The procedures are chamfering both sides of the gudgeon pin and crank pin core and semi-finishing the crank pin bore at a rate of 1000 pieces per hour at 100% efficiency.
